title: Angular Momentum of a Wind Turbine
body: The blades of a wind turbine are $$30\, \text{m}$$ in length and rotate at a maximum rotation rate of $$20\, \tfrac{\text{rev}}{\text{min}}.$$ The blades are $$6000\, \text{kg}$$ each and the rotor assembly has three blades (model each blade as a uniform rod rotating about one end, $$I=(1/3)mL**{2})$$.
